question: In the sodium chlorate droplet experiments, which saturated salt solution set the humidity at which single crystals were most frequent?
expect: sodium bromide: single crystals become more frequent at RH about 59%, which saturated NaBr maintained (LiCl 11%, MgCl2 33%) (Experimental Setup; Results)
